ns2:course.label: Quantitative Analysis Lecture
ns2:course.description: (CHEM 223) Fundamentals of quantitative analysis, chemical equilibrium and kinetics. This lecture course is intended to accompany CHEM 223. Students with credit in CHEM 222 can receive credit for CHEM 203 but not for CHEM 121. Prerequisite: CHEM 104 and CHEM 105 or equivalent.
